### Candidate metadata regressions pass unnoticed The test checks retained text and usage but not candidate metadata, so aggregation could return an incorrect or missing `finish_reason` and still pass; assert that `aggregated.candidates[0].finish_reason` is `genai_types.FinishReason.STOP` and cover the other expected metadata. In `sdks/python/tests/library_integration/genai/test_generations_aggregators.py` around lines 82-85, update `test_aggregate__last_chunk_has_only_usage__text_and_usage_kept` to verify that candidate metadata from the earlier content chunk is retained when the trailing chunk contains only usage data. Add an assertion that `aggregated.candidates[0].finish_reason` is `genai_types.FinishReason.STOP`, along with any other relevant candidate metadata this behavior promises to preserve. ```

### Thought parts remain undocumented and misleading The docstring overstates the behavior: `_merge_parts` merges non-thought text, retains non-thought non-text parts, and discards thought parts, so update it to say that explicitly. Out of Scope Findings (1 Medium, 1 Low)

 `sdks/python/src/opik/integrations/genai/generations_aggregators.py:52`
**Empty streams trigger accidental indexing errors** Empty input currently raises an unhelpful IndexError at `items[-1]` before the aggregation fallback runs; add an explicit check with a clear `ValueError` or route empty streams through the documented best-effort degradation path. `sdks/python/src/opik/integrations/genai/generations_aggregators.py:43-44`
**Streamed inline images stored without base64 normalization** Images from earlier streamed chunks remain as non-rendering base64 strings because `_end_span_inputs_preprocessor` serializes URL-safe base64 without calling `normalize_urlsafe_base64_images_in_place`, while the extractor only accepts standard base64. Normalize the images before `model_dump` and apply the same fix to non-streamed and last-chunk responses.
